name: SciTOX guidance source base example
instructions: This file is loaded by the app server only.
Do not publish customer-facing claims from this file.
Replace placeholders only with owner-reviewed product data, labels, warnings, instructions, policies, and routing rules.
If a customer answer cannot be mapped to an owner-reviewed product path, the route must return human_follow_up.

source_groups.allowed_use: Product matching only after owner-reviewed product data is supplied.
source_groups.content: [OWNER DATA NEEDED: TotalTOX variant names, SKUs, hair-length rules, kit volumes, bottle sizes, labels, prices, ingredients, instructions, warnings, availability, and reviewed variant-path mapping rules.]

source_groups.allowed_use: Restrict route outputs until review is complete.
source_groups.content: [REVIEW REQUIRED: route must not provide legal advice, medical advice, diagnostic advice, test-result advice, outcome guarantees, privacy/security guarantees, vendor approval claims, marketplace eligibility claims, payment-platform safety claims, or unsupported product performance claims.]

source_groups.allowed_use: Escalate when reviewed source material does not support a clear product path.
source_groups.content: [REVIEW REQUIRED: escalate to human support when customer answers are ambiguous, sensitive, outside reviewed product mappings, or require support details not present in the source base.]

product_paths.allowed_use: Human follow-up only until owner-reviewed variant mapping exists.

assistant_output_contract.recommended_product_id: null until owner-reviewed product mapping exists
assistant_output_contract.explanation: short source-grounded explanation, no final claim language
